beats.label: S1 · Two dead Corpos
beats.text: Cassian kills two Pre-Mor officers in a Morlana One brawl. Deputy Syril Karn defies orders to bury the case and traces him to his home on Ferrix.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Establishes Cassian as hunted and introduces Syril, whose obsession with him drives him toward the ISB and Dedra.

beats.label: S1 · Luthen collects him
beats.text: Rebel handler Luthen Rael reaches Cassian first, pulls him off Ferrix under Syril's nose, and hires him for a payroll robbery on Aldhani.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The moment Cassian enters Luthen's orbit — the relationship that defines every S2 mission.

beats.label: S1 · The Aldhani heist
beats.text: The Aldhani heist empties an Imperial sector's payroll but kills most of the crew. Cassian walks away with Nemik's manifesto as the Empire clamps down galaxy-wide.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The rebellion's first real strike; triggers ISB expansion and the surveillance state that shapes S2.

beats.label: S1 · Ferrix pays the price
beats.text: ISB analyst Dedra Meero abducts and tortures Bix for the name behind Aldhani. Cassian, unrelated, is swept up on Niamos and shipped to Narkina 5 prison.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Establishes Dedra as the hunter of 'Axis' and lands the torture that becomes Bix's S2 PTSD.

beats.label: S1 · Mothma's ledger
beats.text: On Coruscant, Mon Mothma bankrolls Luthen's network in secret. To hide the trail, she agrees to promise her daughter Leida to a Chandrilan banker's son.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The arranged marriage that opens S2; frames Mothma's political cover as personal cost.

beats.label: S1 · Narkina 5 breakout
beats.text: Learning prisoners are killed rather than released, Cassian leads a mass Narkina 5 breakout. He returns to Ferrix to find Maarva dead and Bix in ISB custody.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Radicalises Cassian firsthand and pulls him back to Ferrix, where the show's political turn happens.

beats.label: S1 · Rix Road turns
beats.text: Maarva's recorded funeral speech triggers a Ferrix uprising. Cassian frees Bix and boards Luthen's ship to serve; Syril, still hunting, saves Dedra in the riot.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Cassian's full commitment plus the Syril–Dedra collision — both are the launchpad for S2.

cliffhanger.text: Cassian has just handed himself to Luthen's rebellion. Bix flees Ferrix broken by torture, Mon Mothma is trading her daughter's future for cover, and the ISB now knows there is a network — 'Axis' — to hunt.
questions: Can Cassian survive as a full operative under Luthen?
What happens to Bix, offworld and unraveling from Gorst's torture?
Now that Syril has crossed paths with Dedra, what does that put in motion?

characters.name: Cassian Andor
characters.line: Fugitive who has just placed himself under Luthen's command, willing to serve the Rebellion.

characters.name: Luthen Rael
characters.line: Rebel spymaster running his network from a Coruscant antiques shop, now openly sponsoring Cassian.

characters.name: Mon Mothma
characters.line: Imperial senator secretly funding Luthen; has agreed to marry off her thirteen-year-old daughter Leida to cover the missing money.

characters.name: Dedra Meero
characters.line: ISB supervisor who has identified an unknown handler she calls 'Axis' and holds authority over Ferrix.

characters.name: Syril Karn
characters.line: Disgraced ex-Corpo obsessed with Cassian, now working a menial Coruscant desk job; saved Dedra during the Ferrix riot.

characters.name: Bix Caleen
characters.line: Ferrix mechanic tortured by Dr. Gorst; fleeing offworld with Brasso, Wilmon and B2EMO.

beats.label: S2 · One year on
beats.text: A year past Ferrix, Cassian runs missions for Luthen while Bix hides on Mina-Rau, unraveling from Gorst's torture.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Sets the time-jump rhythm and shows the personal cost carrying over from S1.

beats.label: S2 · Krennic seeds Ghorman
beats.text: Orson Krennic quietly launches a plan to strip-mine Ghorman for a secret weapons project, assigning Dedra to fabricate a Ghorman insurgency as pretext.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The engine of the whole season — every later Ghorman beat traces to this decision.

beats.label: S2 · Leida's wedding, Tay's death
beats.text: Mon Mothma marries off her daughter Leida to a Chandrilan banker's son. When her old friend Tay threatens to expose her rebel funding, Luthen has him killed.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Pays off the S1 marriage arrangement and shows how far Luthen will go, straining his bond with Mothma.

beats.label: S2 · Ghorman infiltration
beats.text: Syril, now Dedra's partner, infiltrates the Ghorman rebels. A botched heist kills Cinta; Bix, back in the fight, tortures Gorst with his own device.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Puts Syril inside the trap he doesn't yet see and marks Bix's return to action after S1's damage.

beats.label: S2 · Palmo massacre
beats.text: The Empire orchestrates a massacre in Palmo's square. Realising he has been used, Syril confronts Dedra, then dies in the square after recognising Cassian mid-assassination.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The season's political crisis and the collapse of the Syril–Dedra axis that has run since S1.

beats.label: S2 · Mothma flees, Bix leaves
beats.text: Mon Mothma condemns Palpatine on the Senate floor. Cassian smuggles her to Yavin with a captured KX droid — reprogrammed as K-2SO. Bix slips away to keep him fighting.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Cements the open Rebellion, delivers K-2SO to Cassian, and severs the Cassian–Bix relationship.

beats.label: S2 · Axis falls, Kafrene
beats.text: Dedra corners Luthen as Axis; Kleya finishes him and passes his intel to Yavin. Cassian flies to Kafrene to meet Saw's informant; Bix waits offworld with their child.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Closes the Luthen chapter, hands the shadow war to Kleya and Yavin, and points Cassian directly at what comes next.

cliffhanger.text: Luthen is dead but his final intelligence has surfaced an Imperial superweapon. Cassian is flying to Kafrene to meet Saw Gerrera's informant while Bix, hidden offworld, is raising their child.
questions: What is the informant on Kafrene about to tell Cassian?
With Luthen gone, who now steers the Rebellion's shadow war?
Will Cassian ever meet the child Bix is raising in his absence?

characters.name: Cassian Andor
characters.line: Rebel operative flying to Kafrene to collect intelligence on an Imperial superweapon.

characters.name: Bix Caleen
characters.line: In hiding on Mina-Rau, raising Cassian's child alone while he stays in the fight.

characters.name: Mon Mothma
characters.line: Political face of the open Rebellion on Yavin IV after denouncing Palpatine in the Senate.

characters.name: Kleya Marki
characters.line: Sole surviving member of Luthen's cell, now integrating into the Yavin leadership after killing him herself.

characters.name: Dedra Meero
characters.line: Fallen ISB supervisor, imprisoned in a Narkina-style labor camp for her overreach on Ghorman.

characters.name: K-2SO
characters.line: Reprogrammed Imperial KX security droid now serving as Cassian's partner.
